name: fund-census
description: SEC filings on investment advisers and their private funds: Form ADV advisers, funds, owners, executives and service providers, with Form D fundraising, Form 13F holdings, Schedule 13D/13G stakes, Forms 4/5 insider transactions and Form N-CEN and N-PORT registered fund data. Read-only.

interface.shortDescription: SEC adviser and fund filings, searchable
interface.longDescription: Look up any SEC-registered or exempt reporting investment adviser and the private funds it reports on Form ADV: assets, owners and executives, auditors, custodians, administrators, prime brokers and marketers, due-diligence flags, connected firms and what changed between filings. See Form D fundraising, Form 13F holdings, Schedule 13D/13G stakes, registered fund operations from Form N-CEN and registered fund holdings from Form N-PORT, all linked by exact identifiers. Screen and rank funds and firms, and open interactive profiles right in the chat. Public regulatory data only; not investment advice.
defaultPrompt: Who audits and custodies Andreessen Horowitz's funds?
Show hedge funds over $1B that switched auditors this year
Which firms are connected to Blackstone through shared owners?
capabilities: Search advisers, funds, people and providers
Screen and rank funds and firms
